map.Sigmoid 把任意实数压到 (0,1)，输出可直接当概率用；其导数 σ′=σ: Sigmoid squashes any real number into (0,1) and the output can be used directly as a probability; its derivative σ′=σ(1−σ) approaches 0 for large |z|, one of the root causes of vanishing gradients in deep networks, so hidden layers now mostly use the ReLU family. The threshold need not be fixed at 0.5 and should be tuned to the cost of each error in the business.
map.σ(x)=1/(1+e⁻ˣ)，将任意实数映射到 (0,1)，用于二分类概率化。: σ(x)=1/(1+e⁻ˣ) maps any real number into (0,1) for binary classification probabilities.
map.x=0 时 σ=0.5；x 很大趋近 1、很小趋近 0，具饱和性。: At x=0, σ=0.5; for large x it approaches 1 and for very negative x it approaches 0, so it saturates.
map.与 BCE 损失配合；其导数 σ'(x)=σ(x)(1−σ(x))，便于反向传播: It pairs with BCE loss; its derivative σ'(x)=σ(x)(1−σ(x)) makes backpropagation easy.

map.Sigmoid 和 Softmax 区别？: What's the Difference Between Sigmoid and Softmax?
map.Sigmoid 独立处理每个 logit、输出各维独立概率(可不和为1)，适合多: Sigmoid treats each logit independently and outputs per-dimension probabilities that need not sum to 1, which suits multi-label problems; Softmax normalizes so the class probabilities sum to 1, which suits single-label multiclass classification.
map.为什么 Sigmoid 易饱和导致梯度消失？: Why Does Sigmoid Saturate and Cause Vanishing Gradients?
map.当 |x| 很大时 σ 接近 0 或 1，导数≈0，反向传播梯度趋零；深层网络常: When |x| is large σ approaches 0 or 1 and the derivative is about 0, so the backpropagated gradient vanishes; deep networks usually mitigate this with BatchNorm and ReLU, or use alternatives such as Swish.
